the mechanisms underlying cold hypersensitivity in the rat dorsal horn can be separated into two distinct populations: (i) a TRPM8‐independent population, which includes TRPA1 and Nav1.8 channels, and (ii) a TRPM‐dependent population, which is not affected by TRPA1 and/or Nav1.8 channel antagonism.
